title: council query type
description: The saved form of one council query type. This is what `kbu council query register` validates a YAML against, and what the `spec` column of the store's query_types table holds. A query type is IMMUTABLE once saved under a (name, version): edit it by registering a new version, because a finished job's verdicts only mean anything against the exact spec that produced them.

version.description: A string, not a number: versions sort naturally but are compared as written.

entity_field.description: Which evidence field IS the item -- the one entity_hash() is taken over, so two spellings of it are the same question. Must be one of evidence_fields.

evidence_fields.description: Every evidence key an item may carry. Each becomes a $binding in the template renderer.

menu_fields.description: The metadata keys a menu entry carries, exposed to a candidate template as $meta_<key>.

id_field.description: What an id is called in THIS domain's answers (go_id, rxn_id). postprocess renames it to the generic 'id', and final_<id_field>s to 'final_ids'.

candidate_templates.description: How one menu entry is rendered. Required (both 'full' and 'short') unless the spec names a builtin renderer, which renders candidates in code. Bindings: $rank, $id, $label, $description, $score and $meta_<key>.

critic_truncate_chars.description: How much of the critic's JSON the meta prompt is shown. A byte cut, as in the reference council.

renderer.description: A builtin renderer as '<name>' or '<name>@<version>'. Unset means the string.Template renderer. An installation that does not ship the named version REFUSES the query rather than rendering it with another.

adapter.description: A builtin answer adapter, same spelling as renderer. Unset means the default id rename.

attribution.description: Where these prompts came from. The shipped builtins record the source file, the line range ported and the SHA-256 of each file.

schema.description: JSON Schema the answer must satisfy. A spec with no renderer must use the package's generic schema for the role (generic_schemas.json) with only the id field renamed.

fragments.description: Named prompt text a BUILTIN renderer splices in conditionally, e.g. reaction_pickup's promiscuity_hint.
